description: TensorFeed's signed SSVC patch-urgency decision for one CVE, applying the CISA SSVC Coordinator decision tree to the recorded Vulnrichment decision points (exploitation, automatable, technical impact). Requires a CVE id. tier='preview' is free (10 calls per day per IP): the three decision points and the decision-tree provenance, WITHOUT the computed Act / Attend / Track / Track* decision. tier='full' costs 1 credit ($0.02) and adds the computed decision across the full low/medium/high Mission and Well-being envelope, the per-level reasoning, a live CISA KEV cross-check, and an AFTA-signed receipt. Omit tier and you get the free preview, unless the call carries a payment or credits token (or uses the strict x402 transport), in which case it bills as full. Pay per call with an x402 wallet payment (arguments.payment, or an X-PAYMENT header; strict HTTP-402 transport at https://mcp.tensorfeed.ai/mcp?x402=strict) or use an Authorization: Bearer tf_live_... credits token. No token and no USDC? Claim free trial credits by signing a wallet message at https://tensorfeed.ai/api/payment/trial-credits.

cve.description: CVE id to rule on, e.g. "CVE-2024-3094". Required.

payment.description: Optional base64 x402 payment payload (the same string an X-PAYMENT header would carry). Sign against the accepts[0] requirement returned by an unpaid call. Alternative to the Bearer credits token.

tier.description: 'preview' (free, 10 calls per IP per day) or 'full' (1 credit; adds the computed decision, envelope, reasoning, KEV cross-check, signed receipt). Omitted: preview, unless a payment or credits token is attached.

name: ssvc_verdict
